svg.title: EventBook detailed SysML requirements diagram
svg.desc: Seven core EventBook requirements, their verification methods, customer and administrator workflow derivations, and the server-side integrity constraint.
svg.text: EventBook — Detailed SysML Requirements Diagram
Core functional requirements, workflow derivations and verification evidence
EventBook system boundary
Each requirement is implemented by a Jira story/task and verified by the stated browser, API, terminal or automated-test evidence.
Customer workflow
discover → inspect → simulated checkout → confirmation → manage booking
Administrator workflow
authenticate → monitor → create/edit event → manage bookings
derives
derives
R-01 · Must
Role-based authentication and access
Authenticate a customer or administrator and expose only
role-appropriate functions after a valid demo login.
Verify: customer/admin navigation and invalid-login error · Jira EVENT-4, EVENT-9
Design: demo sessions, Bearer token and server-side requireRole()
R-02 · Must
Event discovery and availability information
Display title, date/time, venue, price and remaining tickets
with search, sort and visual availability indicators.
Verify: home/detail screen and search result · Jira EVENT-5, EVENT-10
Design: Event cards, details, filter bar and availability progress bar
R-03 · Must
Valid ticket quantity and calculated total
Accept a positive whole ticket quantity and calculate the
visible order total before a booking is submitted.
Verify: checkout quantity/total and unit test · Jira EVENT-6, EVENT-13
Design: quantity input, updateCheckoutTotal() and createBooking()
R-04 · Must
Server-side capacity protection
Reject any booking where booked + requested quantity exceeds
capacity; do not write a booking or change event availability.
Verify: over-capacity error and unit test · Jira EVENT-6, EVENT-12
Design: getRemainingTickets() and createBooking() on the API
R-05 · Must
Validated administrator event management
Allow an administrator to create and edit event details with
required values, non-negative price and safe capacity rules.
Verify: Admin dashboard/create-edit form · Jira EVENT-7, EVENT-15
Design: validEvent(), POST/PUT event endpoints and metrics dashboard
R-06 · Must
Persistent event and booking records
Persist events and bookings across Node server restarts using
the JSON repository; demo sessions remain intentionally transient.
Verify: restart/data-file evidence · Jira EVENT-14
Design: readDatabase(), writeDatabase() and data.json
R-07 · Should
Confirmation and authorised cancellation
Show a booking reference and total after success; allow a customer
or administrator to cancel an eligible confirmed booking.
Verify: confirmation, My Bookings and cancellation result · Jira EVENT-11, EVENT-14
Design: receipt, booking history and POST /api/bookings/:id/cancel
Integrity constraint (refines R-03, R-04 and R-06)
The browser can calculate a visible checkout total, but the API is the
authority. It authorises role, validates quantity and capacity, then writes
both booking and event state together. Payment card fields are never sent.
Evidence: booking sequence, API source, automated capacity test and validation screenshot.
